'''Sith shield talismans''' were [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magical]] [[Sith talisman/Legends|devices]] that protected wearers from all forms of energy based attacks, including [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based assaults. These amulets were crafted in the form of necklaces, and worked by absorbing the energy directed at it and storing it as a power source. Shield talismans required an infusion of energy at least once a week.
